correctness.rationale: For h=V+Kz with V symplectic nondegenerate alternating dim 2n, n>=1 over any field including characteristic 2, every derivation preserves one-dimensional center so a local derivation must preserve Kz. Conversely any center-preserving T=(L,ell,c) is pointwise represented by a derivation: for v!=0 choose a symplectic basis and matrix S=[[A,0],[C,-A^T]], C symmetric, with Sv=Lv; choose phi(v)=ell(v)+ct, set D(z)=0. For v=0, choose conformal-symplectic M(e_i)=0,M(f_i)=cf_i and D(z)=cz. Characteristic 2 is covered by alternating-form identities. Der dimension n(2n+1)+1+2n, LocDer dimension 4n²+2n+1; gap n(2n−1). Independent F2 h3 exhaustive count 64 derivations,128 local,128 center-preserving maps. Finite case is corroboration only.
residual_risks: Only nondegenerate alternating one-center Heisenberg family, not arbitrary two-step nilpotent algebras.
